title: Quick match: play anyone, any speed
notes: ⚡ Quick match on Online Play: pick Bullet (1 min or 2 + 1), Blitz (3 + 2 or 5 min) or Rapid (10 or 15 + 10) and get matched with the next player looking for the same game.
Works anywhere, on the website and in the app.
🚩 Reports now go privately by email and are never posted publicly.
